## Findings

- [ ] **[Repo/WARN] All three merge methods enabled without a stated policy**
  - **Status quo:** `mergeCommitAllowed`, `squashMergeAllowed` and `rebaseMergeAllowed` are all `true`. Ruleset "main protection" already restricts merge methods to squash/rebase.
  - **Proposed solution:** Disable `mergeCommitAllowed` in repo settings to match the enforced ruleset.

- [ ] **[Repo/WARN] licenseInfo API reports null despite LICENSE file existing**
  - **Status quo:** `gh repo view --json licenseInfo` returns `null` even though a valid Apache-2.0 `LICENSE` exists.
  - **Proposed solution:** GitHub SPDX detection usually resolves within a few days; if it persists, re-add the LICENSE file to retrigger detection.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact.

- [ ] **[Community/WARN] Missing CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md on a public repo**
  - **Status quo:** No `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`; community profile health 85/100.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add `.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` (Contributor Covenant 2.1).
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact.

- [ ] **[Security/WARN] security-and-analysis endpoint not queryable (GHAS/plan-gated)**
  - **Status quo:** `security-and-analysis` returns 404; feature-toggle state unverifiable with current token/plan. Open alert counts all 0.
  - **Proposed solution:** Verify toggles in the web UI with an admin account.

- [ ] **[CI/WARN] No dedicated lint/static-check workflow**

- [ ] **[CI/WARN] No release workflow despite regular tagged releases**
  - **Status quo:** Releases cut manually; no tag-triggered release workflow.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add a tag-triggered workflow or document the manual procedure in CONTRIBUTING.md.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact.
